q: A sofic shift is defined as the image of a subshift of finite type under a factor map (sliding block code). Every SFT is sofic, but sofic shifts can have:
opts: Non-integer topological entropy that equals log of an algebraic integer
exp: Sofic shifts have topological entropy = log of an algebraic integer (Perron eigenvalue of some non-negative integer matrix). Every SFT is sofic, but the class is strictly larger; sofic shifts include edge shifts of labeled graphs.
